name: quirkwright
topic: Windows host behaviour of coding agents: Claude Code Bash and PowerShell tools, Git Bash/MSYS, Write/Edit tools, Python on Windows

volatile_claims.claim: A quoted Bash-tool heredoc halves doubled backslashes
volatile_claims.repro: cat <<'EOF' with a doubled backslash; count backslashes printed

volatile_claims.claim: Write and Edit tools decode backslash-u escapes
volatile_claims.repro: Write a file holding a backslash-u003c escape; qw.py check flags lost-backslash-u
Write a line ending in two spaces; qw.py check trailing_space_lines

volatile_claims.claim: Git Bash rewrites leading-slash arguments to Windows paths
Python text-mode write produces CRLF on Windows
Python stdout to a redirect is cp1252 and fails on CJK
Bash-tool $! is the MSYS pid, not the Windows pid
A stdin reader in a Bash-tool call hangs to the 120 s timeout
Local-scope MCP servers match the exact project path case
volatile_claims.repro: claude mcp list from d:\x and D:\x

volatile_claims.claim: localhost resolves ::1 first and is slower than 127.0.0.1 for IPv4 servers
Foreground sleep is refused; Monitor watches expire after ~5 min
Plugin cache keeps old versions; installPath names the live one
volatile_claims.repro: qw.py doctor --plugin <name> vs ls of the cache folder

volatile_claims.claim: A skill installed mid-session is not callable with the Skill tool
volatile_claims.repro: install a plugin, call its skill

volatile_claims.claim: Code spans in the VS Code chat panel cannot be copied
volatile_claims.repro: try to select a code span in the panel
